chapter: Reel 4: boyhood bands and the drummers he admired
title: Resuming on August 16: wanting a drum from age four
summary: Francis restarts his story: cardboard Christmas drums that lasted a week, and the family's UNIA membership.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: : August 16th, 1978 Orlando, Florida. Hey, Panama, what were you telling me just then?
Oh, I said that I would like to start talking about when I first started playing drums.
Well, I remember, around the age of
four, that it was Christmas time and my mother and father asked me what I wanted for Christmas, and I told them I wanted a drum.

And it seemed like, even before that time, my mother said that I used to sit at the table after I had finished eating, and had my spoon and I would start beating the rhythm on the table. But I do remember that after I was four, every Christmas, I would always ask for a drum, and this drum would only last me about a week because I would beat a hole through it because it was only made of cardboard.
